description: LEJ PP Search hooks - Redirects WebSearch to Perplexity via direct API calls

hooks.command: echo 'When asked to research or look up current information, use Perplexity via curl instead of built-in WebSearch. Call the Perplexity Agent API directly: curl -s https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/agent with an Authorization header using PERPLEXITY_API_KEY from the environment or ~/.claude/settings.json, and a JSON body with "effort" and "input". Use effort fast by default. Perplexity discovers new information rather than confirming existing knowledge.'
